home.hero_subtitle: Hakykat wagtda tor akymlaryny seljeryan ondebaryjy mashyn okuw ulgamy. DDoS, Brute Force, Port Scan we Zero-Day howplaryny 98% takyklyk bilen anyklayar.
home.how_it_works_subtitle: Cig maglumatdan amaly analitika cenli uc basganjakly pipeline
home.step1_desc: Loopback (lo0) interfeysinde canly paket tutmak. Paketler 74 CICIDS2017 gabat gelyan alamatly iki taraply akymlara birikdirilyer.
home.step2_desc: 2.8M CICIDS2017 akymlarynda okadylan LightGBM klassifikatory hujum gornusini we ynam derejesini caklayar.
home.step3_desc: Wizual dashboardlar, howplulyk boyunca duysduryslar, forensika cuktayslary we CSV hasabat eksporty.
home.demo_subtitle: Dashboard we hujum skriptini iki ayry terminalda isledin
home.demo_terminal1_desc: Dashboard-y sudo bilen baslat (paket tutmak ucin gerek):
home.live_monitor_desc: lo0-da hakyky tor trafikini tutun, akymlara birlesdirin we ML bilen hakykat wagtda hujumlary anyklan.
home.detection_report_desc: Anyklanan howplary, howplulyk bolunmesini, forensik jikme-jiklikleri barl we sessiya maglumatlaryny CSV edip eksport edin.
home.docs_desc: ML modelleri, CICIDS2017 dataseti, feature engineering we hujum gornusleri barada owrentin.

attacks.empty_desc: Howplary anyklamak ucin Canly Monitori canly tor capturasy bilen basladyn we hujum skriptini isledin.
attacks.no_attacks_match: Hazirki filtrler bilen hujum tapylmady. Yokardaky gornus saylawyny uytgedin.
attacks.select_attack_id: Jikme-jik forensika ucin Hujum ID saylan
attacks.rec_ddos: TEKLIP: Agresiw rate limiting ulanyn. Chek gateway-da {src_ip} den gelen ahli trafikni gozden gecirin ya-da taslap bilin.

how_it_works.nad_intro: **Tor Anomaliya Anyklamasy (NAD)** - bu tor trafikindaki adaty bazadan gysayan adatdan dasary nusgalary tapmak prosesi. Bu gysyamalar koplenç howpsuzlyk howplaryny, mysal ucin giris basyp almagy, maglumat cykarmagy ya-da hyzmatdan mahrum etme hujumlaryny gorkezyar.
how_it_works.nad_why_volume: **Mukdar**: Hazirki torlar her sagat milyonlarca akym doredyar -- el bilen barlamaga juda kop.
how_it_works.nad_why_speed: **Tizlik**: Hujumlar saniyalarda gujeyip biler. Awtomatik anyklama hakykat wagt jogabyny mumkin ediryar.
how_it_works.nad_why_sophistication: **Ceperlik**: Hujumcylar taktikasyny hemise uytgedyar. ML-esasly anyklama duzgun-esasly ulgamlaryn goyberyan ozal gorylmedik (zero-day) nusgalaryny tapyp biler.
how_it_works.nad_system_note: Bu ulgam **IDS** -- anomaliyany anyklayar we hasabat beryar. Onlemek (bloklamak) firewall ya-da tor gateway integrasiyasyny talap edyar.
how_it_works.nad_signature_desc: **Imza-esasly**: Trafiki belli hujum nusgalary bilen denesdiryer (antivirus duzgunleri yaly). Belli howplar ucin tiz we takyk, yone taze hujumlara kor.
how_it_works.nad_anomaly_desc: **Anomaliya-esasly**: "adaty" trafik neme digini owrengin we gysan zatlary bellengin. Zero-day hujumlaryny tapyp biler, yone yalnys onyn berip biler. **Bu ulgam mashyn okuwy bilen goldalan anomaliya-esasly anyklamany ulanyar.**
how_it_works.cicids_intro: **Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System 2017** (CICIDS2017) dataseti New Brunswick uniwesiteti tarapyndan doredildi. Ol tor giris anyklama tadkikatynda in kop ulanylyan benchmark datasetlerinden biridir.
how_it_works.cicids_features: **Alamatlar**: CICFlowMeter bilen cykarylan 80+ tor akym alamaty
how_it_works.cicids_protocols: **Protokollar**: HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SSH we email protokollary
how_it_works.cicids_classes_intro: Onislem we klas balansyndan son modelimiz akymlary **7 klassa** bolyar:
how_it_works.cicids_class_dos_hulk: **DoS Hulk** -- Hulk guraly bilen DoS hujumi
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_desc: **LightGBM** (Light Gradient Boosting Machine) - esasy klassifikatorymyz bolup, CICIDS2017 test toplumynda **98.2% takyklyk** gazanyar.
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_how_1: **Leaf-wise agac osmesini** ulanyar (XGBoost-daky level-wise yerine), bu kop wagty tiz konvergensiya we yokary takyklyk beryar.
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_how_2: Uznuksiz alamatlary netijeli islap tayyarlamak ucin **histogram esasly bolunmeni** ulanyar.
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_why_1: Has tiz okadysh we inference (<15ms her batch)
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_why_2: Az yady sarp edyar -- hakykat wagt dashboardlary ucin amatly
how_it_works.ml_lightgbm_params_2: StandardScaler normalizasiyasyndan son 74 sanly alamat bilen okadyldy
how_it_works.ml_rf_desc: **Random Forest** - maglumatyn totanleyin bolumlerinde okadylan karar agaclary ansamblydyr.
how_it_works.ml_rf_how_2: Her agac okadylysh maglumatyn totanleyin nusgasyny (bootstrap) goryar
how_it_works.ml_rf_how_3: Ahyrky caklama ahli agaclar boyuncha **kopluk ses berisi** arkaly edilyar
how_it_works.ml_rf_pros: **Artykmaclyklary:** Overfittinge durnukly, feature importance dusunukli, scaling gerek dal.
how_it_works.ml_rf_cons: **Kemcilikleri:** LightGBM-den has hayyl inference, bu datasetde takyklygy pesrak.
how_it_works.ml_xgb_desc: **XGBoost** (Extreme Gradient Boosting) - regularizasiya edilen gradient boosting frameworkidir.
how_it_works.ml_xgb_how_1: Agaclary **yzygiderli** guryar, her yeni agac ozalky yalnyslyklary duzedyar
how_it_works.ml_xgb_how_2: Overfittingin onuni almak ucin **L1 we L2 regularizasiya** ulanyar
how_it_works.ml_xgb_pros: **Artykmaclyklary:** Gucly regularizasiya, missing value goldawy, GPU goldawy.
how_it_works.ml_xgb_cons: **Kemcilikleri:** Level-wise osme LightGBM-in leaf-wise cemelesinden az netijeli bolup biler.
how_it_works.ml_lstm_desc: **LSTM Autoencoder** - anomaliya anyklamak ucin unsupervised deep learning modelidir.
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_1: **Encoder**: LSTM gatlaklary 78-olcemli girisi 32-olcemli latent meyda gysyar
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_2: **Decoder**: LSTM gatlaklary gysylan gornusden asyl girisi gaytadan dikeldyar
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_3: "Adaty" nusgalary owrensin diye **dine howpsuz trafikde** okadylyar
how_it_works.ml_lstm_how_4: Inference wagtynda yokary **rekonstruksiya yalnyslygy** anomaliyany gorkezyar
how_it_works.ml_lstm_cons: **Kemcilikleri:** Yalnys onyn derejesi yokary, cek sazlamasyny seresap duzmegi talap edyar.
how_it_works.fe_what_desc: **Tor akymy** bir protokoly ulanyyan iki endpoint arasynda (IP:port juti) paketler yzygideridir. Ayratyn paketleri seljermegini yerine, biz olary akymlara birlesdirip statistiki alamatlary cykaryarys:
how_it_works.fe_packet_counts: **Paket sany**: Gidis paketleri, gelis paketleri, jemi paket
how_it_works.fe_byte_counts: **Byte sany**: Gidis byte, gelis byte, jemi byte
how_it_works.fe_timing: **Wagt**: Akym dowamlylygy, paket arasy wagtlar (IAT), isjen/bos wagtlar
how_it_works.fe_tcp_flags: **TCP flaglary**: SYN, ACK, FIN, RST, PSH sany
how_it_works.fe_statistical: **Statistiki**: Paket olcemleri we IAT-lerin orta, std, min, max gymmatlary
how_it_works.fe_scaler_desc: Alamatlary ML modele bermezden on **StandardScaler** ulanarys:
how_it_works.fe_scaler_explain: Bu hemme alamatlaryn orta qiymetini 0 we dispersiyasyny 1 edyar, boyuk magnitudaly alamatlaryn (mysal, bytes/s) kici magnitudaly alamatlary (mysal, flag sany) basyp yitirmeginin onuni alyar.
how_it_works.fe_smote_desc: CICIDS2017 dataseti gaty disbalansly (>80% howpsuz trafik). Klasslary balanslamak ucin **SMOTE** (Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique) ulanarys:
how_it_works.fe_smote_1: SMOTE azlyk klasslary ucin **sintetiki** nusga doredyar
how_it_works.fe_smote_2: Ol bar bolan azlyk nusgalary we olaryn in yakyn gonsularyny interpolasiya edip isleyar
how_it_works.fe_smote_3: Bu modelin hemme zady "BENIGN" diye caklamagynyn onuni alyar
how_it_works.arch_source_live_desc: FlowAggregator bilen loopback (lo0) da Scapy-esasly paket sniffing
how_it_works.arch_source_live_use: Localhost-da hujum iberiji skript bilen demo
how_it_works.arch_threshold_desc: Model her caklama ucin **ynam bahasyny** (0.0 - 1.0) cykaryar.
how_it_works.arch_threshold_rule: **Ynam ceginden** pes bolan akymlar (sus-payy 70%) howpsuz hasaplanylyar
how_it_works.attack_ddos_desc:
DDoS hujumi maksat serweri kop cesmeden gelen uly trafik bilen basyp, kanuny ulanyjylara elyeterli bolmagyny togtadyar. CICIDS2017-de LOIT guraly ulanyldy.

**Nadip isleyar:** Spoof edilen cesme IP-lerden her sekunda munden-munde SYN paketleri maksat tarapa akdyrylyar we birikdirme tablisasynyn resurslaryny tuysetyar.

**Modelin ulanyyan esasy alamatlary:** gaty yokary `Flow Packets/s`, yokary `Flow Bytes/s`, kop `SYN` flagy, juda gysga `Flow Duration`, pes `Bwd Packets` (kopunc bir taraply).

**Garsy cala:** Rate limiting, SYN cookies, trafik scrubbing hyzmatlary, blackhole routing.
how_it_works.attack_dos_hulk_desc:
DoS Hulk keslemegi aylanyp gecmek we web serweri basmak ucin ozbolusly, gizlenen HTTP GET soraglaryny doredyar. Yonekey flooddan tapawutlylykda her sorag basga gorunyar.

**Nadip isleyar:** Keslanmezlik ucin random URL parametrli tiz HTTP soraglary iberilyar. Her sorag serweri doly jogap islemage mejbur edyar.

**Esasy alamatlar:** yokary `Fwd Packet Length`, orta `Flow Duration`, yzygiderli `Fwd Packets` sany, yokary `Flow Bytes/s`.

**Garsy cala:** Web Application Firewall (WAF), her IP ucin sorag tizligini caklemek, CAPTCHA synaglary.
how_it_works.attack_portscan_desc:
Port scanning - maksat hostdaky acyk hyzmatlary tapmak ucin recon tehnikasydyr. Hujumcylar ejiz hyzmatlary tapmak ucin kop porty barlayar.

**Nadip isleyar:** Yzygiderli ya-da random portlara SYN paketleri iberyar. Acyk port SYN-ACK bilen jogap beryar; yapyk port RST bilen jogap beryar.

**Esasy alamatlar:** kop yeke-tak `Dst Ports`, juda kici `Fwd Packet Length` (dine SYN paketleri), gysga `Flow Duration`, yokary `Flow Packets/s`, az `Bwd Packets`.

**Garsy cala:** Portlaryn acyklygyny caklayar firewall duzgunleri, IDS duysdurysy, port knocking.
how_it_works.attack_ftp_desc:
FTP-Patator Patator guralyny ulanyp FTP serwerlerine (port 21) brut-force login synanyslary edyar, kop ulanyjy/parol kombinasiyalaryny synayar.

**Nadip isleyar:** Port 21-e durli maglumatlar bilen gaytalanyan TCP birikmeleri acylyar. Her synansyk autentifikasiya maglumatly gysga akym doredyar.

**Esasy alamatlar:** `Dst Port` = 21, orta `Fwd Bytes` (auth maglumatlary), bir cesmeden kop gysga akym, yzygiderli `Flow Duration`.

**Garsy cala:** Hasap blokirovka syyasaty, fail2ban, gujli parollar, anonim FTP-ni ocurmek.
how_it_works.attack_ssh_desc:
SSH-Patator Patator guraly bilen port 22-de SSH login maglumatlaryny brut-force edip synayar. FTP-Patator yaly, yone SSH protokoly nysana alyar.

**Nadip isleyar:** Durli maglumatlar bilen gaytalanyan SSH birikdirme synanyslary edilyar. SSH handshake ozune mahsus akym nusgasyny doredyar.

**Esasy alamatlar:** `Dst Port` = 22, FTP-den has yokary `Fwd Bytes` (SSH handshake ulyrak), bir source IP-den kop akym, yzygiderli wagt nusgalary.

**Garsy cala:** Dine acarly autentifikasiya, fail2ban, standart dal SSH port, MFA.
how_it_works.attack_bot_desc:
Botnet trafiki yokan hostlar bilen Command-and-Control (C2) serwerin arasyndaky aragatnasygy bildiryer. CICIDS2017-de ARES botneti ulanyldy.

**Nadip isleyar:** Yokan hostlar C2 serwerine periodik baglanyp komanda alyar we maglumat cykaryar. Trafik nusgalary yzygiderli we dowamly bolyar.

**Esasy alamatlar:** yzygiderli `Flow Duration`, durnukly `IAT` (inter-arrival times), orta `Bytes/s`, iki taraply aragatnasyk (hem `Fwd`, hem `Bwd` paketler bar).

**Garsy cala:** Tor segmentasiyasy, DNS sinkholing, endpoint detection and response (EDR).

glossary.network_flow: Bir protokoly ulanyyan iki endpoint arasynda paketler yzygideri (src_ip:src_port ↔ dst_ip:dst_port).
glossary.pcap: Packet Capture -- tutulan tor paketlerini saklamak ucin fayl formaty. Wireshark we tcpdump yaly gurallar doredyar.
glossary.ids_ips: Intrusion Detection System (barlayar we duysduryr) / Intrusion Prevention System (barlayar we bloklayar).
glossary.cicids2017: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection System 2017 -- modellerimizi okatmakda ulanylan benchmark dataset.
glossary.gradient_boosting: Her yeni model ozalky yalnyslyklary duzedyan yzygider ansambl ML tehnikasy.
glossary.lightgbm: Light Gradient Boosting Machine -- Microsoft tarapyndan doredilen tiz, leaf-wise gradient boosting frameworki.
glossary.random_forest: Totanleyin maglumat bolumlerinde okadylan karar agaclary ansambly; caklama kopluk ses bilen edilyar.
glossary.xgboost: Extreme Gradient Boosting -- L1/L2 jerime bilen regularizasiya edilen gradient boosting frameworki.
glossary.autoencoder: Giris maglumatyny gysyp gaytadan dikeldyan neyron tor. Yokary rekonstruksiya yalnyslygy anomaliyany bildiryer.
glossary.lstm: Long Short-Term Memory -- yzygider maglumatda uzak baglylyklary owrip bilyan recurrent neyron tor gornusi.
glossary.smote: Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique -- az synply toparlary balanslamak ucin sintetiki nusga doredyar.
glossary.standard_scaler: Alamatlary orta 0 we dispersiya 1 edip normalizleyar: X_scaled = (X - mean) / std.
glossary.feature_importance: Her alamatyn model caklamasyna nace pay gosdandygyny gorkezyar skor.
glossary.f1_score: Precision bilen Recall-yn garmonik ortasy. Yalnys onyn we yalnys tersleri balanslayar.
glossary.precision: Onyn diyip caklanan mysallaryn nacesi hakykatdan onyn? TP / (TP + FP).
glossary.recall: Hakykat onyn mysallaryn naceisini model tapdy? TP / (TP + FN). Sensitivity hem diyilyar.
glossary.false_positive: Howpsuz akymyn yalnysslyk bilen hujum diye klassifikasiya edilmegi. Gereksiz duysdurys doredyar.
glossary.false_negative: Hujum akymynyn yalnysslyk bilen howpsuz diye klassifikasiya edilmegi. In howply yalnysslyk gornusi.
glossary.confidence_score: Modelin caklan klassyna beren ehtimallygy. Aralyk: 0.0 (ynamsuz) - 1.0 (ynamly).
glossary.confidence_threshold: Akymy hujum diye belgilemek ucin gerek minimum ynam. Sus-payy: 70%.
glossary.severity_level: Ynama gore bellenyer: Orta (<90%), Yokary (90-95%), Kritiki (>95%).
glossary.tcp_flags: TCP header kontrol bitleri: SYN (baglansyk basy), ACK (tassyklama), FIN (gutarmak), RST (reset), PSH (maglumat itermek).
glossary.iat: Inter-Arrival Time -- akymdaky yzygider paketlerin arasyndaky wagt. Awtomat hujumlaryny tapmakda mohum alamat.
glossary.scapy: Paket manipulasiya, captura we craft ucin Python kitaphanasy. Canly captura we hujum iberiji skriptde ulanylyar.
glossary.ddos: Distributed Denial of Service -- kop cesmeden trafik iberip maksady elyetersiz etmek.
glossary.brute_force: Dogrysy tapylynca kop parol kombinasiyasyny synayan hujum. SSH (22) ya-da FTP (21) nysana alyar.
glossary.port_scan: Maksatdaky isleyan hyzmatlary tapmak ucin kop porty barlayan recon tehnikasy.
glossary.botnet: Hujumcy tarapyndan Command-and-Control (C2) arkaly dolandyrylyan kompromat hostlar tory.
glossary.c2: Botnetde kompromat mashynlara komanda iberyan serwer.
